{{Top}}
'''Shah-tezh''' was a game invented some time prior to the [[third Galactic War]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]]'s friend from the [[Agriculture Administration]] was an outstanding Shah-tezh player.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=general|Jedi Under Siege|Ossus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shah-tezh was created for ''[[Aftermath: Empire's End]]'', a [[canon]] novel published in [[2017]]. The game was later referenced in the [[2018]] ''Jedi Under Siege'' update for the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']], the [[2016]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', though the game is part of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.
